audit.whatIsWrong: This page gives Volibear five straight rows (L2 through first item). The already-audited mirror set Level 1 and Level 2 to Garen, Levels 4-5 to Skill and First item to Skill.
audit.why: Garen's Decisive Strike is free and on 8s flat, and Courage grants tenacity on cast, so the early rows are not Volibear's. Mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement, so both layers are flipped here to match.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Garen / Garen / Volibear / Skill / Volibear / Skill / Skill, ratings 4/4/7/5/7/5/5 from Volibear's side.

audit.why: Level 3 and level 6 are genuinely Volibear's spikes: Sky Splitter (16s flat) completes the pattern and Stormbringer (160s at rank 1) disables the tower for a dive. Garen's spikes are Courage online and his level-6 execute.
audit.corrected: Retained; the level-6 line now carries the 160s number and the Decisive Strike caveat.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] and spikes[1] both tell the player to E-slow so Garen 'can't Q-run'. Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows.
audit.why: Riot's text for Garen Q: 'Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him.' That removes Sky Splitter's slow and Stormbringer's slow outright, which is the single decisive interaction in this lane.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter cannot hold him once Q is up — commit before he casts it and kill with damage, not with kiting.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage's tenacity is never mentioned; the page treats it purely as damage reduction.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction'. Tenacity shortens Thundering Smash's stun, which is what the whole pattern is built on.
audit.corrected: Courage is 22s at rank 1 and gives shield plus tenacity on cast, so your stun is cut short if you commit into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perseverance's condition is not stated anywhere.
audit.why: It only regenerates while he has not recently been struck by damage or abilities — Frenzied Maul's chip is what denies it.
audit.corrected: Keep chipping and Perseverance never ticks.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] writes 'Relentless Storm' for Volibear's passive.
audit.why: The passive is The Relentless Storm; the packet flagged it. The second suspect, 'Bait Decisive Strike', is a false positive — the name itself is correct.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade. Garen's Decisive Strike costs nothing and is up every 8 seconds, so he wins the first walk-up before your passive ramps.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Garen has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Courage grants tenacity on cast — it shortens your stun and shields the bite, so level 2 still favours him.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Garen down every time Courage is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Decisive Strike breaks every slow you have — your Sky Splitter cannot hold him for the full bite.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Garen to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky crit-heals your first hit, but Courage's damage cut lands at the same time — first item reads even, not won.

edits.before: Level 1 is an even skill check on dodging his Q silence.
edits.after: Level 1 Garen's free 8s Q silence beats your mana-gated kit.

edits.before: At level 2 your ramping passive out-sustains his early regen.
edits.after: At 2 Courage's shield and tenacity blunt your stun and bite.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your DPS keeps him shoved and denied.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out: his Q breaks your E slow.

edits.before: By first item your Sheen spike out-DPS his damage-reduction.
edits.after: By first item his Courage damage cut trades evenly with Sheen.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is an even skill check on his Q silence, but neither of you commits hard yet.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 go to Garen: Decisive Strike is free and up every 8s, and Courage blunts your stun.

edits.before: You out-trade Garen here — his Decisive Strike (Q) silence is his only engage, so bait it, then W-maul and Q-stun him while it's down; your Relentless Storm ticks beat his passive regen before he can reset with Courage (W).
edits.after: You out-trade Garen here — his Decisive Strike (Q) silence is up every 8s, so bait it, then W-maul and Q-stun while it's down; The Relentless Storm ticks deny Perseverance, which only regens when he is untouched.

edits.before: Stormbringer wins the all-in: leap in, E-slow so he can't Q-silence-run, and your passive DPS drops him before Demacian Justice (R) executes — his ult only matters if you're already low, so trade from health.
edits.after: Stormbringer wins the all-in: leap in on 160s, and your passive DPS drops him before Demacian Justice (R) executes. Decisive Strike breaks your slows, so kill him with damage, not with kiting — and trade from full.

edits.before: E-slow so he can't Q-run out of your DPS
edits.after: Fight before Q — it breaks your E slow

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction on cast. All-in once it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Garen Decisive Strike: Cleanses slows, gains move speed; next auto silences and deals bonus damage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1; shield plus tenacity on cast, so your stun is shortened. All-in once it is down. - Garen Decisive Strike: 8s, free, breaks every slow you have and silences your next cast. Judgment is 9s at rank 1.

notes: The old page told the player to E-slow Garen so he could not run — Decisive Strike explicitly breaks free of all slows, so that was advice in the wrong direction and it appeared in two places. Whether Courage's tenacity window is long enough to matter against a stun already applied, versus only reducing a stun applied during it, is not in Riot's text and is not asserted anywhere in the rewrite.
